key_highlights: Energy stocks lift ASX on rising oil prices amid tanker war tensions; oil supply disruption risk elevated
BHP under severe pressure as iron ore prices crumble, prompting strategic review of operations
Australian housing price falls accelerate dramatically; RBA signals no rescue intervention for property market
Gold exploration sector active: Forrestania hits 2Moz, Kaiser adds Tassie ounces, Larvotto strikes NSW gold-antimony-tungsten
BYD declares Australia has passed EV tipping point, threatening legacy auto and consumer discretionary
Mortgage costs driving Australians into second jobs; consumer sentiment deteriorating
El Nino intensifying in Eastern Pacific, posing agricultural and energy demand risks
Trump policy threats and US midterm uncertainty adding global risk premium

sectors.trend: Iron ore weakness pressures BHP and peers; gold exploration remains resilient with multiple discoveries (Forrestania 2Moz, Kaiser Tassie, Larvotto NSW). Uranium exploration (Infini 7.5% source) adds optionality.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX faces margin compression and potential strategic restructuring. Gold juniors (FOR.AX, KAE.AX, LAR.AX) attract speculative flows. Diversify away from iron ore concentration.

sectors.trend: Oil prices rising on tanker war tensions; energy stocks outperforming ASX. Renewable energy zone dispute (landholders) signals policy uncertainty for transition.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, and oil-exposed names benefit short-term. Renewable policy friction (headline 1) creates execution risk for clean-energy capex. LNG names (WDS.AX) supported by commodity strength.

sectors.trend: Accelerating housing price falls raise NPL concerns for major banks. RBA unlikely to cut aggressively, limiting rate-driven net interest margin relief. Mortgage stress driving second-job uptake.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face elevated credit risk in residential book. Defensive positioning warranted. REITs (VCG.AX, SGP.AX) pressured by falling property valuations.

sectors.trend: BYD's EV tipping-point declaration disrupts auto sector. Consumer squeeze from mortgage costs reduces discretionary spend. Tobacco tax fight adds political noise.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. Auto retailers under threat from BYD penetration. Tobacco (BAT, LOR.AX) faces regulatory headwind.

sectors.trend: AI stocks off highs; Burry exits Alibaba. Australia faces AI worker shortage driving skilled migration policy. Drones disrupting defence procurement.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (W1.AX, XRO.AX) volatile. Defence (RWL.AX, NRG.AX) may see drone-related disruption. Skilled migration policy (Pocock) supports long-term tech talent pipeline.

key_themes: Commodity bifurcation: oil up, iron ore down
Housing correction accelerating without RBA intervention
EV transition accelerating in Australia via BYD
Gold exploration renaissance across multiple jurisdictions
Geopolitical risk (Trump, tanker wars, El Nino) elevating volatility

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse / BHP strategic distress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX and FMG.AX exposure; rotate into gold and energy hedges

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing price acceleration in decline / bank NPL spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight banks and property REITs; monitor RBA statements for policy pivot

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical escalation (tanker wars, Trump policy, El Nino)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain 10-15% cash allocation; hold energy and gold as hedges

risk_assessment.risk_factor: EV disruption to legacy auto and consumer sectors
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid auto-exposed consumer names; monitor BYD market share data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Renewable energy policy uncertainty / zone void claims
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid early-stage renewable developers until policy clarity; favour established generators

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy and oil-exposed names on tanker war premium
opportunities.rationale: Oil rising, tanker wars unlikely to suppress supply; WDS and WLE benefit from sustained $80+ oil

opportunities.recommendation: Selective gold exploration exposure on discovery wave
opportunities.rationale: Forrestania 2Moz, Kaiser Tassie, Larvotto NSW strikes signal sector-wide upside; gold hedges geopolitical risk
7.5% uranium source in Canada is high-grade; nuclear renaissance supports long-term demand

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce BHP and iron ore exposure; rotate to diversified miners
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural downtrend; BHP strategic review signals potential value destruction

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight banks and property REITs pending housing stabilisation
defensive_moves.rationale: Accelerating price falls with no RBA rescue; NPL build-up likely through 2026-27

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash and short-duration bonds as geopolitical hedge
defensive_moves.rationale: Trump policy risk, tanker wars, El Nino create tail-risk scenarios; 10-15% cash buffer prudent

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely range-bound to slightly lower. Energy outperformance offsets materials weakness. Housing data and RBA commentary dominate. Oil volatility from tanker tensions adds noise. Expect 2-3% index volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from iron ore decline and housing correction weigh on 6-12 month outlook. Gold, energy, and selective tech offer relative strength. Consumer squeeze persists. RBA constrained by fiscal politics. Moderate bearish bias unless iron ore stabilises.
